title: Sothys celebrates its 80th anniversary with new ambitions
summary: In 2026, Sothys celebrates 80 years of beauty dedicated to salon and spa professionals. Still firmly rooted in the Corrèze region, in South-Western France, the brand is looking to change its business model without compromising on the basics behind its success, particularly on the global level. Next milestone for the company: speeding up its digital transformation.
